reason: It says halal-certified but doesn't say who certified it, and I've never seen any of the creators I follow mention RizqPure or anyone in my family group use it. £18 is fine, but I won't put collagen from a brand I don't know into my tea until I'm sure about the halal side.
objection: Who actually certified it? 'Halal-certified' with no certifier's name or certificate means nothing to me, and 4.8 stars on their own site could be anyone.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the certifying body's name and the actual certificate on the site, plus a Muslim beauty creator I trust or someone in my WhatsApp group saying they've used it and seen results.
